THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4 (1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labourwhich accompanies this order exists between,
Mr. A. D. Jayasinghe, No. 735, Sudarshana Mawatha, Himbutuwelgoda, Kelaniya.
and
Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation, No. 15, Rock House Lane, Colombo15.

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 RevisedEdition), as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act,No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint,
Mr. L. R. Sumathipala, Principal Quarters, Nurses' Training School, Kandy to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaiddispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.12th September, 2018.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. A. D. Jayasinghe, No. 735, Sudarshana Mawatha, Himbutuwelgoda, Kelaniya of the one part
and
Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation, No. 15, Rock House Lane, Colombo15. of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether the non-payment of the 04 salary increments due from 01.04.2005 and the arrears in respect of the same and thepromotions to the posts of Senior Supplies Officer and Supplies Manager not been given to Mr. A. D. Jayasinghe who workedas a supplies Officer of the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation are just and if not so, to what reliefs he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo this 28th day of August, 2018.
